title: {{name}} and the Little Dino
text:
{{name}} loved dinosaurs very much. One day, {{name}} walked in the green park. Then {{name}} heard a small cry. It came from a big bush. {{name}} looked behind the bush. A baby Stegosaurus sat there. It was lost and very sad. The baby could not find its mom.

{{name}} wanted to help the little dino. But the park was big and dark. {{name}} felt a bit scared. The baby looked up with big eyes. So {{name}} was brave and smiled. "I will help you," {{name}} said.

They walked and walked for a long time. {{name}} did not stop, because the dino needed help. Soon they came to a big tree. A mother Stegosaurus stood near the tree. The baby ran fast to its mom. The mother dino was so happy.

The mom gave {{name}} a soft, warm look. {{name}} felt warm and very glad. Now {{name}} had a new dino friend. Kind hearts can find a way home.

questions.prompt: Where did {{name}} find the baby dino?
Who did the baby dino find at the big tree?
